description: This file defines the 'provenance' package for tracking build information of the kustomize binary, including version, build date, and runtime details. It includes functions to retrieve and parse build info, and to generate version strings.

classes.name: Provenance
classes.description: Struct holding build metadata such as version, commit, build date, OS, architecture, and Go version.

methods.name: GetProvenance
methods.description: Returns an instance of Provenance with current build info.

methods.name: FindVersion
methods.description: Searches for the version in build dependencies or main info.

methods.name: GetMostRecentTag
methods.description: Extracts the most recent semantic version tag from a module.

methods.name: Provenance.Short
methods.description: Returns a short string representation of Provenance.

methods.name: Provenance.Semver
methods.description: Returns the semantic version string of the provenance.
